title: Charge Baby, Charge!
subtitle: Smarter than the Sphinx, hotter than the flames of Nirvana, and faster than Boreas, our chariot of war shall crush every lie and injustice.

trails.title: Matilda's School Report
trails.description:
This sheet is a school report and the signature block says "Matilda Bouanich." The score has been blackened on purpose, and you can only see a jotting: "The number of points I need to reach full marks is exactly the number implied by h-h-her name. Why? Why?!"
So what is Matilda Bouanich's score?

items.text: Charge Baby, Charge!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Dear Freddy, could you make the "Auto Island" move faster? Our Ms. Sonetto has something really urgent!

items.speaker: Freddy The Driver
items.text: Miss, we cannot speed up anymore. Mr. Karson will be mad if we race in the woods.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Oh ... then how long will it take to The Walden?

items.speaker: Freddy The Driver
items.text: Probably ... half an hour.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Oh my ... it's too long! We promised Ms. Sonetto to find her friends, right?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: We keep going slowly, we will miss Ms. Vertin!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Fine. Freddy. Quick. Drink it!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: It's the "Bravery Charging Hopping Potion" I made this morning! Just drink it!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Er, what are you ... Wait a minute!

items.speaker: Freddy The Driver
items.text: *swallowing*

items.speaker: Freddy The Driver
items.text: Mi-Miss ... you are really going ... to sell ... your potion ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: See? Now you've got a lot more strength, right?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: I added the most effective tears of the pure-blooded Koresck and the strongest bile acid of blue lobster.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Definitely makes you forget the fears, and be courageous, and excited for two whole days without food and drink!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Ms. Sotheby, did you feed him a whole bottle of that? It's too dangerous!

items.speaker: Freddy The Driver
items.text: Whoaaaaaa!!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Too bad ... he doesn't look right ... Hold the handrail!

items.speaker: Freddy The Driver
items.text: Whoa, whoa, whoahhh, I've never feel so good in my whole life! Charge baby, charge, charge to high Heaven!

items.speaker: Freddy The Driver
items.text: The wheels on the bus go round and round, round and round, round and round ...♪

items.speaker: Sonetto&Sotheby
items.text: Woaaah!!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: No way ... too fast! The speed ... i-i-it's illegal in the city. Ahhhhhh!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hey, Freddy! We're at the bar already! Don't ... step on it!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: St-stop ... already ... help ...!

items.speaker: Sonetto&Sotheby
items.text: Hitting the wall!!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Oh ... it hurts.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Ms. Sotheby, Ms. Sotheby, are you alright?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Um ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Where are we? I know we crashed into the back wall of The Walden …

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Yes. But it looks like ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... like an underground labyrinth.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Whoa ...! Di-did we really crash into the back wall of the bar?! The "Auto Island" ... it's stuck in the wall?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Freddy! Oh ... fortunately you just passed out.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Oh ... This is too bad. This is real bad ... If Mr. Karson knows I broke the barkeeper's wall ... oh ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The car stuck in the wall ... We have to find another way out.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Le-let's get out of here quickly, before Mr. Karson knows it!
*appear*

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Gosh! The crash just now wakened the critters in the underground ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hm? Let me see what it looks like!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Ah! It's the Carbuncle that's parasitic on the dust! They all act in groups. Generally speaking, if you see one Carbuncle, it means ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: There's a large group of Carbuncles around here ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: We have to beat them before we leave.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Ok. Let's do it! M-my alchemy will definitely come in handy!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Freddy ... leave him to me. I will carry him.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Ms. Sotheby, you seem to know The Walden better. Please lead the way.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Sure! No problem! Though it looks different from the bar I imagined, I will definitely find the right way out!
Please ... help me ...
Schneider ... it hurts so much ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Who's there?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hm? Who are you talking to?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I just heard ... Is it my mistake?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: No. It's not.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The liquid flowing out of the wall ... It's a mixture of human blood and vomitus.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: This is ... Truth Serum?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Ms. Sonetto? Why are you talking to yourself against the wall? If you want to get out soon, follow me!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I will be there right away.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Okay. I already know where to go! Follow Sotheby. Let's go left!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... It shouldn't be a mistake. There is a human imprisoned by arcanum in this speakeasy. I have to report it to the Timekeeper as soon as possible.
TO BE CONTINUED…
